items: 1 small sturdy cabbage head (about 4–5 cups shredded), preferably green/white (or red)
1 1/2 tbsp vinegar (ACV or regular; or lemon juice)
4 tbsp oil (vegetable, sunflower, or olive oil)

steps: Remove 2–3 outer cabbage leaves. Quarter cabbage, cut out and discard thick core/root. Shred cabbage into small, even pieces.
Transfer to a large bowl. Add vinegar and oil. Lightly squeeze to help the cabbage sweat while staying crunchy. Let sit 30–60 minutes.
Add salt and a pinch of sugar. Toss well. Adjust seasoning/dressing to taste.
